arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Blatt argued the Federal Circuit decision forecloses judicial review.
She stated the disability prevents timely filing with the Veterans Court.
Mr. Miller argued the Court reaffirmed statutory time limits as jurisdictional.
He cited the longstanding treatment of appeal time limits in Bowles v. Russell.
